identity.name: CL-STA-1020 HazyBeacon — mscorsvw.exe DLL Side-Load, AWS Lambda-URL C2 and Cloud-Storage Exfil (T1574.002 / T1102 / T1567.002)
identity.summary: Endpoint + NGFW stitched chain for the Unit 42 HazyBeacon report: side-load staging, msdnetsvc service persistence, Lambda-URL-shaped beaconing, a C2-delivered collector/uploader toolkit (WildFire threat logs carrying the six published tool sha256s), host-named split archives, cloud-storage upload attempts and clean-up, joined on src_host by CR-MP-0026.
identity.description: CL-STA-1020 targeted Southeast Asian government entities for documents on a tariff and trade dispute. HazyBeacon (mscorsvc.dll) is placed in C:\Windows\assembly\ beside the legitimate mscorsvw.exe and loaded when that binary runs from its registered service; a service named msdnetsvc keeps it loading across reboots. The backdoor beacons to an actor-controlled AWS Lambda function URL (the report redacts it), receives commands and pulls tools into C:\ProgramData\: 7z.exe, the igfx.exe collector, GoogleGet.exe and Google Drive / Dropbox uploaders. The collector zips files in a time range by extension into an archive named after the machine, 7-Zip splits it into ~200 MB volumes, upload to Google Drive and Dropbox is attempted, and the archives and payloads are deleted. The simulation reproduces each stage with inert stand-ins against a lab host and emits the NGFW WildFire records for the six downloaded tools with their published hashes.

campaigns: CL-STA-1020 espionage against Southeast Asian government entities over tariff and trade-dispute documents (2024-2025)

biocs.name: MP-026 mscorsvc.dll Written Beside a Relocated mscorsvw.exe
biocs.description: A signed mscorsvw.exe is written outside %WINDIR%\Microsoft.NET and a DLL named mscorsvc.dll is written into the same directory by the same causality — the HazyBeacon side-load staging pair.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE and event_sub_type in (ENUM.FILE_CREATE_NEW, ENUM.FILE_WRITE, ENUM.FILE_RENAME)
| filter lowercase(action_file_name) in ("mscorsvw.exe", "mscorsvc.dll", "libmscorsvc.so", "mscorsvw")
| filter lowercase(action_file_path) not contains "\\microsoft.net\\framework"
| alter dir = arrayindex(regextract(lowercase(action_file_path), "^(.*)[\\\\/][^\\\\/]+$"), 0)
| comp count_distinct(action_file_name) as pair, values(action_file_path) as paths by agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_instance_id, dir
| filter pair >= 2

biocs.name: MP-026 Service msdnetsvc Created for a Relocated mscorsvw.exe
biocs.description: A service named msdnetsvc (or any service whose image is an mscorsvw.exe outside the .NET Framework directory) is created; on Linux the equivalent is a write of /etc/systemd/system/msdnetsvc.service — the report's persistence for the side-loaded DLL.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter (event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START and lowercase(action_process_image_name) = "sc.exe" and lowercase(action_process_image_command_line) contains " create " and (lowercase(action_process_image_command_line) contains "msdnetsvc" or (lowercase(action_process_image_command_line) contains "mscorsvw.exe" and lowercase(action_process_image_command_line) not contains "\\microsoft.net\\framework"))) or (event_type = ENUM.FILE and event_sub_type in (ENUM.FILE_CREATE_NEW, ENUM.FILE_WRITE) and action_file_path = "/etc/systemd/system/msdnetsvc.service")
| fields _time, agent_hostname, actor_effective_username, actor_process_image_name, action_process_image_command_line, action_file_path, causality_actor_process_instance_id

biocs.name: MP-026 HazyBeacon Collector and Uploader Set Written Under ProgramData
biocs.description: One causality writes three or more of igfx.exe, GoogleGet.exe, google.exe, GoogleDrive.exe, GoogleDriveUpload.exe and Dropbox.exe under C:\ProgramData — the report's collector and cloud-storage uploader set.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE and event_sub_type in (ENUM.FILE_CREATE_NEW, ENUM.FILE_WRITE)
| filter lowercase(action_file_path) contains "programdata" or action_file_path contains "cortexsim-mp026"
| filter lowercase(action_file_name) in ("igfx.exe", "googleget.exe", "google.exe", "googledrive.exe", "googledriveupload.exe", "dropbox.exe", "igfx", "googleget", "google", "googledrive", "googledriveupload", "dropbox")
| comp count_distinct(action_file_name) as tools by agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_instance_id
| filter tools >= 3

biocs.name: MP-026 Host-Named Archive of Keyword-Matched Documents Split into Volumes
biocs.description: A causality creates an archive named after the host and then writes numbered volume files (.001/.002 or 7z -v) of it in the same directory — the igfx.exe + 7z.exe collection pattern.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE and event_sub_type in (ENUM.FILE_CREATE_NEW, ENUM.FILE_WRITE)
| filter lowercase(action_file_name) ~= "\.(zip|tgz|7z)(\.[0-9]{3})?$"
| alter short_host = lowercase(arrayindex(split(agent_hostname, "."), 0))
| filter lowercase(action_file_name) contains short_host
| alter is_volume = if(action_file_name ~= "\.[0-9]{3}$", 1, 0)
| comp sum(is_volume) as volumes, count() as writes by agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_instance_id
| filter volumes >= 2

biocs.name: MP-026 Side-Load Causality Deletes Its Own Archives and Payloads
biocs.description: The causality that wrote the archive volumes and the collector/uploader executables deletes them — the report's post-exfil clean-up.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE and event_sub_type = ENUM.FILE_REMOVE
| filter lowercase(action_file_name) ~= "\.(zip|tgz|7z)\.[0-9]{3}$" or lowercase(action_file_name) in ("igfx.exe", "googleget.exe", "google.exe", "googledrive.exe", "googledriveupload.exe", "dropbox.exe", "igfx", "googleget", "google", "googledrive", "googledriveupload", "dropbox")
| comp count() as deletions, count_distinct(action_file_name) as distinct_files by agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_instance_id
| filter distinct_files >= 3

abiocs.name: MP-026 Recurring Web Egress from the mscorsvw.exe Side-Load Causality
abiocs.description: A process whose causality chain is rooted in mscorsvw.exe (never an HTTP client in its learned baseline) opens a tight recurring series of outbound web sessions to one destination. Keys on behaviour, not the redacted Lambda URL.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_STREAM_CONNECT
| filter lowercase(causality_actor_process_image_name) in ("mscorsvw.exe", "mscorsvw") or causality_actor_process_image_path contains "cortexsim-mp026" or lowercase(actor_process_image_name) in ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "curl", "curl.exe")
| filter action_remote_port in (80, 443, 8080)
| comp count() as sessions, count_distinct(action_remote_ip) as dests, values(actor_process_image_name) as egress_procs by agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_instance_id
| filter sessions >= 3 and dests = 1
abiocs.causality_anchor: Learned mscorsvw.exe service-process baseline (no outbound HTTP) -> recurring single-destination web egress from the side-load causality, anchored on causality_actor_process_instance_id.

abiocs.name: MP-026 NGFW Recurring HTTPS Beacon from the Side-Load Host
abiocs.description: NGFW EAL behavioural alert: the side-load host (src_host) makes a tight recurring burst of small HTTPS sessions to one fleet-rare destination. The destination is a preset because the report redacts the Lambda URL; the record stitches on src_host.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw
| filter app in ("ssl", "web-browsing") and dst_port = 443
| comp count() as sessions, avg(bytes_sent) as avg_bytes, count_distinct(dst) as dests by src, endpoint_device_name, url_domain
| filter sessions >= 6 and dests = 1 and avg_bytes < 4096
abiocs.causality_anchor: Learned per-source-host egress baseline -> recurring rare-destination HTTPS cadence on the same src_host as the endpoint side-load chain.

abiocs.name: MP-026 Staged Archive Volumes Uploaded to Cloud-Storage API Paths
abiocs.description: A process descended from the side-load causality reads split archive volumes and POSTs them to Google Drive / Dropbox upload API paths.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter causality_actor_process_image_path contains "cortexsim-mp026" or lowercase(causality_actor_process_image_name) in ("mscorsvw.exe", "mscorsvw") or lowercase(actor_process_image_name) in ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "curl", "curl.exe")
| filter (event_type = ENUM.FILE and lowercase(action_file_name) ~= "\.(zip|tgz|7z)\.[0-9]{3}$") or (event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_STREAM_CONNECT)
| alter is_read = if(event_type = ENUM.FILE, 1, 0), is_conn = if(event_type = ENUM.NETWORK, 1, 0)
| comp sum(is_read) as volume_reads, sum(is_conn) as uploads by agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_instance_id
| filter volume_reads >= 1 and uploads >= 2
abiocs.causality_anchor: Read of host-named archive volumes followed by outbound upload sessions inside one side-load causality_actor_process_instance_id.

correlation_rules.name: CL-STA-1020 HazyBeacon Side-Load to Cloud-Storage Exfil — Endpoint + NGFW on src_host
correlation_rules.logic: BIOC(MP-026 mscorsvc.dll Written Beside a Relocated mscorsvw.exe) AND BIOC(MP-026 Service msdnetsvc Created for a Relocated mscorsvw.exe) AND ABIOC(MP-026 Recurring Web Egress from the mscorsvw.exe Side-Load Causality) AND (IOC(file-sha256 igfx.exe) OR XQL(MP-026 HazyBeacon Toolkit sha256s Landed in panw_ngfw_threat_raw)) AND ABIOC(MP-026 Staged Archive Volumes Uploaded to Cloud-Storage API Paths) joined on agent_hostname = endpoint_device_name (src_host) within 3600 seconds -> ONE incident

threat_scenarios.name: HazyBeacon Side-Load to Lambda-URL C2 to Cloud-Storage Exfil
threat_scenarios.description: Validate that the endpoint side-load chain and the NGFW threat-log evidence of the C2-delivered toolkit for one host become one CL-STA-1020 incident.

threat_steps.objective: Endpoint BIOC/ABIOCs fire on the side-load host and the six toolkit sha256s land in panw_ngfw_threat_raw for the same src_host; CR-MP-0026 raises ONE incident.
preconditions: NGFW threat logs ingested via an HTTP collector.
steps: Run SIM-MP-026 with TARGET_HOST/TARGET_IP set to the endpoint.
Wait for the correlation window to converge.
success_criteria: Endpoint and NGFW alerts share one src_host.

preventive_controls: Block or alert on any write of a DLL into C:\Windows\assembly or beside a relocated signed binary; enforce Behavioral Threat Protection on side-load patterns.
Restrict service creation to change-managed admin accounts and alert on services whose image is a framework binary outside its install path.
Inspect and control egress to *.lambda-url.*.on.aws and to unsanctioned cloud-storage upload APIs from servers; require SSL decryption so WildFire sees delivered tools.
detection_engineering: Key the side-load BIOC on the file-write pair (signed host binary + import-named DLL) outside the binary's install path, not on the DLL hash.
Correlate endpoint causality with NGFW threat logs on src_host so the WildFire verdict on a delivered tool joins the endpoint incident.
